We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! Why Do Tigers Spray This Strange Liquid? 🐅 When a tiger sprays urine onto a tree, it isn’t just marking territory—it’s leaving behind a chemical message. The scent can reveal information about the tiger and signal to others that the area is already occupied. This powerful form of scent communication helps tigers defend territory, find potential mates, and avoid unnecessary confrontations in the wild.
